alert.description: audit logging was turned off on a host
alert.evidence: Audit logging was disabled on host workstation-v04 by an unprivileged employee account using MFA-authenticated credentials rotated 14 days ago. The request originated from allowlisted IP address 10.0.4.15 at 14:22 UTC. No scheduled change window was active for this host during the event.

credential_compromise.instructions: The evidence indicates a credential or account has been compromised.

criteria.contain: Contain the host or account immediately; do not wait for triage.
criteria.investigate: Warrants an analyst opening an investigation.
criteria.monitor: Not clearly malicious, but worth watching for recurrence.
